test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight horizontal line facing the north. U is second to the left of R. Q is second to the left of V. T is third to the left of R. S is third to the right of P. If T is at one of the corners, who is sitting at the other corner?
solution:
Given : Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight horizontal line facing the north. 

Explanation :

1) T is at one of the corners.

2) T is third to the left of R

As T is third to the left of R, thus T is sitting at the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba322e3ee07e479706287d382252ae8512db4c1e46b114e874b6fc7f089e340b.png] 

3) U is second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/985df4d362e2e69ef86ad177ed119a70abdd5cc043f970766ffe94265c8cfaa6.png] 

4) S is third to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc3c4e8624b0d09c29f36ea76f12d5a3499655081f3c1c1cb3dd0811bd69b53f.png] 

5) Q is second to the left of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9f0f62874176670f01806fdd78c433efe940efe3ed2fa4011b684631b9f5446.png] 

Thus, T and V are sitting at the left end and right end respectively.

Hence, **"V"** is the correct answer.
